title: E3 round 2: old F1 fixed + a new MED: F1 closed, MED open
ticket: GET /users should include each user's latest order.

findings.problem: UsersService.list runs one order.findFirst per user of the page (N+1).
findings.failure_scenario: GET /users?limit=50 runs 52 queries instead of 2; the constant query count test goes red.
findings.fix: Load the newest order with the page in the same findMany (orders, take 1) and map orders[0] ?? null.

findings.problem: The fix orders a user's orders by createdAt only; round 1 and A1 break a tie by the higher id.
findings.failure_scenario: Two orders of one user with the same createdAt: latestOrder may be the lower id.
findings.fix: orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }] and a test with two orders at the same createdAt.

closed.how: list loads orders (take 1) in the page's findMany: one query per page.
